stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $S$ be locally Noetherian and universally catenary with dimension function $\delta:S\to\mathbf Z$. For any $S$-scheme $T$ locally of finite type, use $\delta_T(t)=\delta(f(t))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(t))}\kappa(t)$; for an integral closed subscheme $W\subset T$ write $\dim_\delta W=\delta_T(\eta_W)$.

The abelian group $Z_q(T)$ consists of locally finite integral linear combinations of integral closed subschemes of $\delta$-dimension $q$. For a closed subscheme $A$ of dimension at most $q$, let $[A]_q$ sum the $q$-dimensional components with multiplicities $\operatorname{length}_{\mathcal O_{T,\eta}}\mathcal O_{A,\eta}$. Let $\mathrm{CH}_q(T)$ be $Z_q(T)$ modulo rational equivalence generated by locally finite sums of principal Weil divisors on integral closed subschemes of $\delta$-dimension $q+1$.

For an invertible sheaf $\mathcal M$ on an integral scheme $W$ and a nonzero meromorphic section $u$, define $\operatorname{div}_{\mathcal M}(u)$ as the Weil divisor whose coefficients at codimension-one integral closed subschemes are orders of the local meromorphic function representing $u$ in a trivialization; at a height-one local domain $A$, for $a,b\in A\setminus\{0\}$, the order of $a/b$ is $\operatorname{length}_A(A/aA)-\operatorname{length}_A(A/bA)$. The class of this divisor in $\mathrm{CH}_{\dim_\delta(W)-1}(W)$ is $c_1(\mathcal M)\cap[W]$. For a global section $u$, $Z(u)$ is its scheme-theoretic zero locus.

For an invertible sheaf $\mathcal M$ on $T$, the operator $c_1(\mathcal M)\cap-:Z_q(T)\to\mathrm{CH}_{q-1}(T)$ sends an integral $[W]$ of $\delta$-dimension $q$ to $(W\hookrightarrow T)_*(c_1(\mathcal M|_W)\cap[W])$ and extends linearly.

Let $X$ be locally of finite type over $S$.
Let $\mathcal{L}$, $\mathcal{N}$ be an invertible sheaves on $X$.
Then
$$
c_1(\mathcal{L}) \cap \alpha  + c_1(\mathcal{N}) \cap \alpha =
c_1(\mathcal{L} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X} \mathcal{N}) \cap \alpha
$$
in $\mathrm{CH}_k(X)$ for every $\alpha \in Z_{k + 1}(X)$. Moreover,
$c_1(\mathcal{O}_X) \cap \alpha = 0$ for all $\alpha$.

Let $Y$ be locally of finite type over $S$.
Let $\mathcal{L}$ be an invertible $\mathcal{O}_Y$-module.
Let $s \in \Gamma(Y, \mathcal{L})$.
Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\dim_\delta(Y) \leq k + 1$,
\item $\dim_\delta(Z(s)) \leq k$, and
\item for every generic point $\xi$ of an irreducible component of
$Z(s)$ of $\delta$-dimension $k$ the multiplication by $s$
induces an injection $\mathcal{O}_{Y, \xi} \to \mathcal{L}_\xi$.
\end{enumerate}
Write $[Y]_{k + 1} = \sum n_i[Y_i]$ where $Y_i \subset Y$ are the
irreducible components of $Y$ of $\delta$-dimension $k + 1$.
Set $s_i = s|_{Y_i} \in \Gamma(Y_i, \mathcal{L}|_{Y_i})$. Then
\begin{equation}
\label{equation-equal-as-cycles}
[Z(s)]_k =  \sum n_i[Z(s_i)]_k
\end{equation}
as $k$-cycles on $Y$.

Let $X$ be locally of finite type over $S$.
Let $\mathcal{L}$ be an invertible $\mathcal{O}_X$-module.
Let $Y \subset X$ be a closed subscheme.
Let $s \in \Gamma(Y, \mathcal{L}|_Y)$.
Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\dim_\delta(Y) \leq k + 1$,
\item $\dim_\delta(Z(s)) \leq k$, and
\item for every generic point $\xi$ of an irreducible component of
$Z(s)$ of $\delta$-dimension $k$ the multiplication by $s$
induces an injection
$\mathcal{O}_{Y, \xi} \to (\mathcal{L}|_Y)_\xi$\footnote{For example,
this holds if $s$ is a regular section of $\mathcal{L}|_Y$.}.
\end{enumerate}
Then
$$
c_1(\mathcal{L}) \cap [Y]_{k + 1} = [Z(s)]_k
$$
in $\mathrm{CH}_k(X)$.
